title: 禮貌用語
description: 有禮貌地提出請求與回應

sentences.en: Would you mind closing the door?
Could you please repeat that?
I'd appreciate it if you could help me.
sentences.zh: 如果你能幫我，我會很感激。

sentences.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，這個位子有人嗎？

sentences.en: May I ask you a question?
sentences.zh: 我可以問你一個問題嗎？

sentences.en: Please take your time.
After you.
I don't mean to bother you, but...
Would it be possible to reschedule?
I hope I'm not interrupting.
Do you mind if I sit here?
Could I trouble you for a moment?
I would be happy to help.
Please feel free to let me know.
I'm sorry to keep you waiting.
Would you like me to hold the door?
That's very kind of you.
I'd rather not, if you don't mind.
sentences.zh: 如果你不介意的話，我不太想。

sentences.en: Pardon me, could you point me to the exit?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，可以指一下出口在哪嗎？

sentences.en: I was wondering if you could spare a minute.
sentences.zh: 不知道你能不能撥一分鐘？

sentences.en: Please don't hesitate to ask.
It was a pleasure meeting you.
I really don't want to impose.
sentences.zh: 我真的不想造成你的負擔。

sentences.en: Would you be so kind as to pass me the salt?
I appreciate your patience.
No worries at all.
Please make yourself at home.
sentences.zh: 請不要客氣，當作自己家。

sentences.en: If it's not too much trouble, could you help?
sentences.zh: 如果不會太麻煩的話，能幫個忙嗎？

sentences.en: I'm much obliged.
Go ahead, I'll wait.
